name: 33620 · Tampa, FL
findings: ZIP 33620 (Tampa) has 55 nonprofit organizations. 29 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 24 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33620 (Tampa) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
93% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 33620 (Tampa) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 93% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
